turns.reply:
I changed `rich/console.py` so that a `BrokenPipeError` raised while writing the console buffer calls a new `Console.on_broken_pipe()` method, which quiets the console, redirects stdout to devnull and raises `SystemExit(1)`.

The write logic moved unchanged into `_write_buffer()`, and `_check_buffer()` now wraps it in the try/except. I ran the three buffer/quiet/record tests in `tests/test_console.py` and they pass. I did not write a dedicated broken-pipe test, and the exact exit behaviour is my best reading of the issue rather than something I checked against it.
